Container.Name: channelarr
Container.Overview: Channelarr filters an Xtream Codes IPTV account down to the channels you want and publishes an M3U playlist plus a matching XMLTV guide for Jellyfin Live TV. Streams are redirected to the provider, not proxied. Locally built image, so Unraid can not check it for updates.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web UI and the M3U/EPG/stream links for Jellyfin

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address written into the M3U and EPG links. Leave empty to use the address the request came in on.
